question: Which problems exceed the total number of times they appear in the solution table when counting all occurrences, across steps 1, 2, and 3, where any non-"Stack" model's maximum test score is lower than the "Stack" model's test score for the same step and version?
sql:
-- Let me see all 7 rows
SELECT sc.name
FROM (
    SELECT ss.name, SUM(CASE WHEN nms.max_non_stack_score < ss.test_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as condition_count
    FROM (SELECT name, version, step, test_score FROM model_score WHERE model = 'Stack') ss
    JOIN (SELECT name, version, step, MAX(test_score) as max_non_stack_score FROM model_score WHERE model != 'Stack' GROUP BY name, version, step) nms
    ON ss.name = nms.name AND ss.version = nms.version AND ss.step = nms.step
    WHERE ss.step IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY ss.name
) sc
JOIN (SELECT name, COUNT(*) as solution_count FROM solution GROUP BY name) sol
ON sc.name = sol.name
WHERE sc.condition_count > sol.solution_count
ORDER BY sc.name
